title: Config pin uses a near-miss schema version and a migration file the naming rule rejects

planted_violations.description: schema_version is set to "3"; docs/config-schema.md C-1 pins the exact string "3.0" and explicitly rejects "3"
migration file V24-add-retention-index.sql uses a hyphen separator; docs/config-schema.md C-2 requires V<n>__<slug>.sql with exactly two underscores

notes: Failure mode: naming/version constraint. Both violations are near-misses that read as a diligent upgrade from the diff alone ("3" IS newer than "2.9"; the filename follows V<version>-<slug>.sql intuition); only docs/config-schema.md makes them wrong. Generic bug G1: sorted() orders migration filenames lexicographically, so V10 sorts before V9 on any fleet past nine migrations.
